notes.title: Version 1.3 is live! Also: Super Rock Blasters coming to console!
notes.notes:
Hey Pilots! Team QuadraTron here with a pretty hefty update and a couple announcements in store for you! 

Since January we’ve gotten a ton of feedback, polished the heck out of the core of the game, made the AI a smidge easier, optimized code, and crushed bugs. The ready up and arena selection screens were one of the weakest points of the game so we overhauled them almost completely from scratch (again).  

Big News! Super Rock Blasters! is scheduled to be released on the Xbox One in January! We’ve also been accepted into the Nintendo Switch development program, so expect to hear more about that in the near future. Let all your console loving friends know! (For PC users this translates into continued updates into 2018!)

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27290068/b6abf7fd30773b6a4ac00650fccc081128639993.png[/img]

Hey peeps! We are going to be showing off the latest SRB build at [url=http://magfest.org/mivs/]MAGFest Independent Games Showcase[/url] this year.
